title: CLO6.1 New Features Live Broadcast Replay
description:
The CLO6.1 new features live replay is out~
We apologize that during this live broadcast, due to building network maintenance and Bilibili live room maintenance on the same day, the bullet comments couldn’t be sent, and the video froze several times. Little C was so upset in the live room 55555TAT.
So! If you have any questions or want to learn more about the new features in CLO6.1, feel free to tell us in the comments!!!
Little C and the instructors will gather everyone’s feedback and include an Easter egg segment for interaction and Q&A in upcoming masterclass live streams~
Let’s get those triple comments going!!!

chunks.title: CLO6.1 New Features Live Broadcast Replay
chunks.content: # CLO6.1 New Features Live Broadcast Replay This document details the new features and updates introduced in CLO 6.1 software. It covers enhancements in the user interface, 3D and 2D editing tools, virtual model customization, file handling, add-on management, logic editor improvements, material and fabric handling, and export options, providing technical explanations, procedures, and examples for effective use. --- ## Overview of CLO 6.1 Update Modules This section introduces the 10 modules covered in the CLO 6.1 update, highlighting key structural changes and new tool placements aimed at improving workflow and accessibility. - The toolbar has been relocated from the top to the left side of the interface to accommodate an increasing number of tools and ensure all are easily visible. - Integration with the Closet Connect website enables direct access to product sales and purchased items from within the software. - Closet Connect, developed by Closet Lab and MaxPlace, is an open resource platform for sharing and downloading clothes, fabrics, and accessory files, including free resources. - New models have been added to the library, including female models, a male model, and a black model. --- ## Editor 3D: New Direct 3D Editing Tools This section explains the three new tools in the Editor 3D, designed for direct manipulation within the 3D window, with synchronization to the 2D window. ### Tools Overview: 1. **Editor Shape Line Tool** - Select the version to edit. - Drag points on the shape line to adjust curves; connected points move together. - Moving the line changes the frequency of the shape. - Changes are reflected simultaneously in the 2D window. 2. **Zoom Shape Line Tool** - Allows zooming in on specific shape lines or points to increase line frequency for detailed editing. 3. **3D Shape Line Tool** - Click shape lines on the 3D version. - Double-click to create straight lines; left-click to create curves. - The version shape updates dynamically with shape line edits. --- ## Selection Grid and Fold Control in 3D Editing This section describes the selection grid tool and fold control features used to isolate, adjust, and freeze grid sections and fold details within the 3D window. - Brush settings including strength, focal length, and size can be adjusted for precise grid selection. - Grids in the 3D window are thinner for better visibility. - Horizontal separation of grids is possible to focus on specific areas. - Grid selection is available both in 3D and 2D windows, with options to fix or freeze grid movement during editing. - Fold portions of the model can be selected and adjusted to maintain fold details during simulation without affecting the overall model shape. --- ## Virtual Model Face Customization This section outlines how to customize virtual model appearances, including facial features, skin, hair, and makeup. - Select the virtual model and enter Edit mode. - Choose from various body and skin models. - Hair and skin color can be selected from a color card with multiple mixing modes to achieve different effects.

chunks.content: - Fold portions of the model can be selected and adjusted to maintain fold details during simulation without affecting the overall model shape. --- ## Virtual Model Face Customization This section outlines how to customize virtual model appearances, including facial features, skin, hair, and makeup. - Select the virtual model and enter Edit mode. - Choose from various body and skin models. - Hair and skin color can be selected from a color card with multiple mixing modes to achieve different effects. - Eyebrow and lip shapes and colors are customizable. - Foundation color and other makeup details can also be adjusted. - The interface is currently in English with plans for translation. --- ## UV Editor Enhancements and Texture Management Details the updates in UV Editor mode for texture creation, saving, and application. - Allows creation of unified stickers to apply textures consistently across versions. - Users can save backup textures in PNG, JPG, or newly added PDF formats. - Simultaneous saving options include text, metal, hair, light, and transparency maps. - Texture maps can be replaced with unified textures in the editor, importing saved UV maps. - Texture adjustments are possible within the UV editor. --- ## GRTF Unified Format Import and Export This section covers the new GRTF unified format allowing physical properties and textures to be imported/exported efficiently. - Physical properties and textures can be imported into GRTF format (FabricGRTF). - Export fabric selection allows choosing specific fabrics and file types for export. - Substance fabrics cannot be exported due to licensing restrictions. - Imported GRTF files can be managed as objects, and materials applied separately. - Supports GRTF 2.0 format for modern compatibility. --- ## 3D Clothing Record and Pose Management Explains the new feature to save and manage 3D clothing records as GPRG files to facilitate design iteration and comparison. - 3D clothing records can be started and stopped via the History Record panel. - Modifications to clothing can be recorded as new 3D clothing records. - Saved records are embedded within the GPRG file. - Pose changes can be applied to the model and recorded with the costume. - Enables easy comparison through history management during the design process. --- ## Rotation Center Axis Settings for 3D Video Recording Introduces options for setting the rotation center axis during 3D video recording for better framing and control. - Three modes for rotation center: 1. **Automatic** - centers rotation between costume and virtual model. 2. **3D Logo Center** - rotates around the X and Z axis center of the 3D logo. 3. **Manual Axis Input** - user inputs X and Z axis values for precise centering. - Allows camera to rotate until the model is centered. - Supports video recording in both AVI and new MP4 formats. --- ## 3D Window Optimizations: Fast Frame and Grid Display Highlights improvements in 3D window display and fast frame saving. - Grid display option added to facilitate layout creation during fast frame saving.

Fast frame saving supports better visual layout management. - "Distribute JRTF" function enables saving of color information and costume animations within JRTF files. - Drafting supports username/password entry and options to save color and costume animations. --- ## Substance Fabric Application Extensions Details new capabilities to apply Substance materials beyond fabrics. - Substance materials can now be applied to virtual models, buttons, and add-ons. - Material properties can be switched from PBR to Substance in the property editor. - Enables enhanced realism and material variety across multiple object types. --- ## User Interface and Layout Customization Covers updates to UI color settings, layout saving, and default views. - Private views and quick view formats (MVS) are supported for faster loading. - Solid layout options provide better adaptation to clothing and objects during file saving/opening. --- ## DXF File Import and Optimization Describes new features supporting DXF file handling and import accuracy. - Options to remove or convert non-plot points during DXF import. - Allows deletion of points without plot numbers or conversion to recognized plot points. - Supports importing IUL files with password protection. - Enables better recognition and editing of address lines in imported files. --- ## 3D Basics Pen and Folding Arrangement Improvements Explains new 3D drawing and folding features to enhance pattern editing. - 3D Basics Pen tool allows drawing basic lines in 3D/2D windows. - Lines can be unlocked and adjusted with the edit version tool. - Inner pocket lines can be integrated into basic lines for streamlined editing. - Folding arrangement now supports symmetry: folding one side automatically folds the other. - Fold angles can be adjusted for realistic simulation. --- ## Pattern Rendering and Shape Line Adjustments Details enhancements in pattern rendering and shape line editing. - Allows editing inner and outer lines of patterns with Z-axis positioning. - Helps display hidden inner lines clearly by adjusting Z-axis values. - Example: Adjusting the bottom hem circular line of a T-shirt when layered under pants. - Improves pattern visualization and accuracy in rendering. --- ## 2D Function Optimizations: Finished Pattern Version and Inner Line Creation Discusses new 2D pattern creation features and inner line enhancements. - Finished Pattern Version tool allows creation of patterns via pop-up dialogs.
